# Trading Economics
> Global economic indicators, market data, calendars, news, charts, and forecasts for 196 countries.

Trading Economics provides access to more than 20 million economic indicators, historical series, market prices, country data, and forecasts across macroeconomics, financial markets, and commodities. The platform combines country pages, indicator databases, market quotes, economic calendars, and API access for research, analysis, and application development.

## Core Data & Navigation
- [Calendar](https://tradingeconomics.com/calendar): Economic calendar with upcoming releases, events, consensus, previous values, and importance levels.
- [News Stream](https://tradingeconomics.com/stream): Real-time economic and market news covering countries, indicators, and asset classes.
- [Indicators](https://tradingeconomics.com/indicators): Directory of macroeconomic indicators by topic, country, and category.
- [Countries](https://tradingeconomics.com/countries): Browse country pages with indicators, forecasts, news, and market data.
- [Markets](https://tradingeconomics.com/markets): Overview of global financial markets, prices, performance, and asset classes.
- [Forecasts](https://tradingeconomics.com/forecasts): Country-level economic forecasts across key macroeconomic indicators.

## Markets
- [Commodities](https://tradingeconomics.com/commodities): Commodity prices, performance, charts, and market summaries across energy, metals, and agriculture.
- [Indexes](https://tradingeconomics.com/stocks): Global stock market indexes with quotes, historical data, and performance tables.
- [Shares](https://tradingeconomics.com/shares): Equity market coverage with company shares, prices, and market performance.
- [Currencies](https://tradingeconomics.com/currencies): Foreign exchange rates, currency performance, and historical market charts.
- [Crypto](https://tradingeconomics.com/crypto): Cryptocurrency prices, market capitalization, and historical performance data.
- [Bonds](https://tradingeconomics.com/bonds): Government bond yields and sovereign debt market data across countries.
- [Earnings](https://tradingeconomics.com/earnings): Corporate earnings calendar with reporting dates and market expectations.

## Forecasts
- [Country Forecasts](https://tradingeconomics.com/forecasts): Forecast tables for GDP, inflation, interest rates, unemployment, and other macro indicators.
- [Commodity Forecasts](https://tradingeconomics.com/forecast/commodity): Forecasts for commodity prices across energy, metals, and agricultural products.
- [Stock Market Forecasts](https://tradingeconomics.com/forecast/stock-market): Forecasts for major stock market indexes by country and region.
- [Currency Forecasts](https://tradingeconomics.com/forecast/currency): Exchange rate forecasts for major and emerging market currencies.
- [Crypto Forecasts](https://tradingeconomics.com/forecast/crypto): Cryptocurrency price forecasts for major digital assets.
- [Government Bond Forecasts](https://tradingeconomics.com/forecast/government-bond-10y): Forecasts for 10-year government bond yields across countries.

## Indicator Categories
- [GDP](https://tradingeconomics.com/country-list/gdp): GDP levels and growth data across countries and regions.
- [Inflation Rate](https://tradingeconomics.com/country-list/inflation-rate): Consumer inflation rates with country comparisons and historical values.
- [Interest Rate](https://tradingeconomics.com/country-list/interest-rate): Central bank policy rates and benchmark interest rates by country.
- [Unemployment Rate](https://tradingeconomics.com/country-list/unemployment-rate): Labor market unemployment rates across countries and regions.
- [Balance of Trade](https://tradingeconomics.com/country-list/balance-of-trade): Trade balance data with country rankings and historical series.
- [Current Account](https://tradingeconomics.com/country-list/current-account): Current account balances and external sector comparisons by country.
- [Government Debt to GDP](https://tradingeconomics.com/country-list/government-debt-to-gdp): Public debt ratios for sovereign fiscal analysis.
- [Population](https://tradingeconomics.com/country-list/population): Population statistics and demographic comparisons across countries.

- [United States](https://tradingeconomics.com/united-states/indicators): US indicators, forecasts, news, and market data.
- [Euro Area](https://tradingeconomics.com/euro-area/indicators): Euro Area macro indicators, releases, and regional forecasts.
- [China](https://tradingeconomics.com/china/indicators): China economic indicators, market data, and forecasts.
- [Japan](https://tradingeconomics.com/japan/indicators): Japan macroeconomic data, releases, and market indicators.
- [United Kingdom](https://tradingeconomics.com/united-kingdom/indicators): UK indicators, forecasts, and economic calendar coverage.
- [India](https://tradingeconomics.com/india/indicators): India economic data, forecasts, and market-related indicators.
- [Brazil](https://tradingeconomics.com/brazil/indicators): Brazil macroeconomic indicators, forecasts, and country news.
- [Germany](https://tradingeconomics.com/germany/indicators): Germany indicators, releases, and market-linked economic data.

- [Natural Gas](https://tradingeconomics.com/commodity/natural-gas): Natural gas prices, charts, historical series, and forecasts.
- [Gold](https://tradingeconomics.com/commodity/gold): Gold spot price data, charts, and market forecasts.
- [Silver](https://tradingeconomics.com/commodity/silver): Silver prices with historical performance and forecast data.
- [Copper](https://tradingeconomics.com/commodity/copper): Copper market prices, charts, and industrial commodity outlook.
- [Wheat](https://tradingeconomics.com/commodity/wheat): Wheat prices with agricultural market history and forecasts.
- [Coffee](https://tradingeconomics.com/commodity/coffee): Coffee commodity prices, charts, and historical performance.

## Currencies, Crypto, and Bonds
- [EURUSD](https://tradingeconomics.com/eurusd:cur): Euro to US dollar exchange rate quote and chart.
- [GBPUSD](https://tradingeconomics.com/gbpusd:cur): British pound to US dollar exchange rate data.
- [USDJPY](https://tradingeconomics.com/usdjpy:cur): US dollar to Japanese yen forex quote and history.
- [Bitcoin](https://tradingeconomics.com/btcusd:cur): Bitcoin price in US dollars with chart and market data.
- [Ethereum](https://tradingeconomics.com/ethusd:cur): Ethereum price data, historical performance, and charting.
- [US 10Y Bond](https://tradingeconomics.com/united-states/government-bond-yield): US 10-year government bond yield series and forecasts.
- [Germany 10Y Bond](https://tradingeconomics.com/germany/government-bond-yield): Germany sovereign bond yield data and historical trends.
- [Japan 10Y Bond](https://tradingeconomics.com/japan/government-bond-yield): Japan government bond yield data with charts and outlook.

## News & Calendar Coverage

- [United States Calendar](https://tradingeconomics.com/united-states/calendar): US economic releases, events, and scheduled announcements.
- [Euro Area Calendar](https://tradingeconomics.com/euro-area/calendar): Euro Area economic calendar with releases and consensus estimates.
- [China Calendar](https://tradingeconomics.com/china/calendar): China economic events and data release schedule.
- [Japan Calendar](https://tradingeconomics.com/japan/calendar): Japan calendar of macroeconomic releases and events.
- [United Kingdom Calendar](https://tradingeconomics.com/united-kingdom/calendar): UK economic calendar with upcoming data and announcements.

## API & Developer Resources
- [API](https://api.tradingeconomics.com): Trading Economics API endpoint for programmatic access to data and forecasts.
- [API Documentation](https://docs.tradingeconomics.com): Documentation for authentication, endpoints, parameters, and response formats.
- [Indicators API](https://docs.tradingeconomics.com/indicators/): API reference for retrieving economic indicators and historical series.
- [Calendar API](https://docs.tradingeconomics.com/calendar/): API reference for economic calendar events and release schedules.
- [Markets API](https://docs.tradingeconomics.com/markets/): API reference for market quotes, commodities, currencies, and bonds.
- [Forecast API](https://docs.tradingeconomics.com/forecast/): API reference for country and market forecast data.
- [News API](https://docs.tradingeconomics.com/news/): API reference for accessing economic and market news feeds.
- [Client Libraries](https://docs.tradingeconomics.com/libraries/): Official and community libraries for integrating Trading Economics data.
